FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_FOOTWORK_POWER: Every 5 Footwork immediately converts into 1 Dodge. Footwork decreases by 1 at the start of each turn.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_DODGE_POWER.de: Acts as a buffer before Block. Each stack negates 1 attack.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_COUNTER_MANAGE: You may retain up to {Amount} Counter card(s) at the end of your turn. Whenever you are attacked, play the first Counter card in your hand.
FLAMETAIL_COUNTER_RETAIN_PROMPT: Choose a Counter card to retain.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_DASH_WEAVE_DOD: Whenever you play a card, gain {Amount} [gold]Footwork[/gold].
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_STEP_GAMBIT_PO: Whenever you gain Footwork, draw 1 card.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_IGNORE_BLOCK_P: The first few Attacks you play this turn ignore Block.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_CAN_YOU_SEE_ME: Whenever you lose Dodge, draw {Amount} card(s).
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_REFLEX_MOVE_PO: The first {Amount} card(s) you play each turn that grant(s) Footwork cost 0.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_TWO_HANDED_STY: Whenever you would gain Footwork, gain {Amount} Block instead. Your attacks deal 25% more damage.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_PROFICIENCY_PO: Innate. Whenever you play an Innate card, draw 1 card.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_PARRYING_DAGGE: Whenever you Counter, deal {Amount} damage to the attacker and gain {Amount} Block.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_TENACITY_POWER: Whenever you draw a Curse or Status card, gain {Amount} Block. Damage and HP loss from Curse and Status cards are halved (does not stack).
Innate. Whenever a Curse card enters your discard or exhaust pile, gain 1 Strength.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_STEADY_STEP_PO: Footwork no longer decreases at the start of your turn.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_EXTRA_COUNTER_: You may retain {Amount} additional Counter card(s) this turn.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_RESTORE_STRENG: Strength lost this turn will be restored at the end of the enemy's turn.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_LOFTY_PRINCIPL: The first {Amount} times you draw a Curse, discard it and draw 1 card.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_PAST_IS_PAST_P: When a Curse card enters your discard pile, Exhaust it instead.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_HIGH_VELOCITY_: Whenever you gain Footwork, gain 1 Strength until the start of your next turn.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_EVEN_FASTER_PO: Your Footwork cannot fall below 2. This power does not stack.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_FORESIGHT_POWE: At the end of your turn, you may retain {Amount} additional Counter card(s).
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_RESOURCEFULNES: At the start of your turn, add a random Counter card to your hand, preferring from your draw pile.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_FIRE_DANCING_S: Counter effects that target only the attacker now affect all enemies.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_HARDENED_VANGU: Whenever you Counter, execute that Counter effect an additional time.
FLAMETAIL_POWER_FLAMETAIL_CORNERED_RECAL: In {Amount} turn(s), return all Curse and Status cards in your exhaust pile to your discard pile.
